newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares continuing to tumble, P&U in focus.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares continuing to tumble, P&U in focus.

text.p: Swedish shares continued to post losses in light trade on Tuesday morning with car safety equipment maker Autoliv Inc leading the fall and the market waiting for drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn's earnings.
The Stockholm general index fell 0.64 to 3,151.15 after shares worth 1.02 billion crowns were traded.

Autoliv tumbled 11.5 to 284 crowns after falling overnight in New York. The stock had risen after posting a $177 million profit after financial items for the first six months of 1997 but fell after the company warned of continuing price pressure, particularly in the U.S..
The only sectors to post gains were drugs and forestry.
In the drugs branch, U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn rose four to 298 crowns ahead of posting its second quarter results.
The market was expecting earnings per share of 36 cents.
Drugs major Astra rose 1.5 to 147 crowns.
The other bourse heavyweight, telecoms group Ericsson, dropped four to 355 crowns.
The forestry sector rose 0.54 percent. MoDo rose 2.5 to 274.5 crowns while Stora edged up 0.5 to 131.5 crowns.
